Shri Rajesh Dubey, Non-Executive Independent Director, Member of the NRC and Chairman of the CSR Committee of the company, passed away on 13th July 2025.
To fill the vacancy, the Board appointed Mr. Vivek Saihgal (DIN: 11228713) as an Additional Director (in the capacity of Independent Director) of the Company with effect from 14th August 2025, whose appointment was regularized at the AGM held on 26th September 2025 and subject to the approval of members he was appointed as an Independent Drector of the company for a term of five consecutive years i.e. from 14th August 2025 to 13th August 2030.
Consequent to his appointment, Mr. Vivek Saihgal (DIN: 11228713) was inducted as a Member of the NRC and Chairman of the CSR Committee with effect from 14th August 2025.
